title: Preparation method for 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid
abstract: 本发明涉及一种2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备方法，所述方法包括以下步骤：原料2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯在碱性物质存在下于三级醇溶剂中发生酯解反应得到2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐；2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐在碱性物质存在下与醇反应或者将2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐反应，得到所述2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸。本发明提供的制备方法以三级醇为溶剂，原料在碱性物质存在下发生酯解反应，降低了杂质的含量，目标化合物的收率和品质得到了大幅的提升，为最终合成高品质环磺酮和呋喃磺草酮原药提供了保障。

bibliographic.legal_status: Pending (application published, not granted as of retrieval)

patent_summary: The document discloses a two-step batch route to 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid from methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate: the methyl ester is first cleaved by a basic substance (sodium or potassium hydroxide, a sodium or potassium tert-alkoxide, an alkali metal hydride, or the alkali metal itself) in a tertiary alcohol solvent, tert-butanol, tert-amyl alcohol or 2-methyl-2-pentanol, to give the alkali metal 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate; that carboxylate salt is then etherified at its benzylic bromide, either with 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol or 2-tetrahydrofurylmethanol in the presence of a base or with the preformed alkali metal alkoxide of the same alcohol, in acetonitrile, DMF, DMSO or THF, and the free acid is recovered by solvent removal, dilution with water, acidification with hydrochloric acid, filtration and drying. Dependent claims recite the tertiary alcohols and the bases, solvent volume per mole of substrate, the substrate-to-base and salt-to-alcohol molar ratios, reaction times, and the order in which base, alcohol and the carboxylate salt are charged in the second step.
novelty_claims: The background at [0007] to [0010] names CN105601548A, CN104292137A, US6376429, CN1364160A and CN1323292A as etherifying the methyl ester first and saponifying afterwards, and objects that in that order the ester suffers base cleavage or transesterification, the liberated methanol alkylates the benzylic bromide, and the resulting 2-chloro-3-methoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid is "not easily removed" and "ultimately seriously affects the quality of the tembotrione and tefuryltrione technical material". Claim 1 answers that by inverting the sequence, cleaving the ester before etherification so that, as [0023] puts it, the method "removes the methoxy group before etherification" and no methanol is present when the benzylic bromide is displaced; [0060] positions this as avoiding "the main impurity present in the prior art" and thereby raising both intermediate quality and yield. The second objection is one the patent raises against its own order of steps: [0024] states that conventional means of ester hydrolysis "are not feasible in this invention, because the benzyl bromide group would take part in the reaction and generate large amounts of benzyl alcohol and dibenzyl ether type compounds", and the answer claim 1 gives is the tertiary alcohol solvent, which [0026] describes as a system that "can very well reduce the reactivity of the benzyl bromide". Claim 7 adds the charging order as part of what is claimed, base and alcohol into the solvent before the carboxylate salt, which [0046] says "cannot be changed" because reversing it makes the benzyl alcohol and double-attachment impurities increase greatly.
